node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e puts offering in Scope. node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f, node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 put promotional linkage in Scope. A false condition therefore produces OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than the typed question's negative Boolean. node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5 similarly does not return compliance outside linked promotion. A deliberately restricted assessment domain is a possible explanation, but requires clarification.

The two offer-level candidates combine offer-level promotion with an existential non-discount gift component without explicitly binding the promotional connection to that same component. This can overinclude mixed-purpose offers unless the supplied classifications establish the connection.

The circular's local definition supports limiting distributors to intermediaries distributing SFC-authorised funds. The quoted paragraph 3.11 uses broader investment-product language; these local formulas do not establish its exhaustive scope.

Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to FAQ question 1 issued on 30 September 2010 are identified by the source but absent as external dependencies. Can their applicable texts be supplied to verify the complete gift standard?

Gift status, discount status and offer attribution remain supplied judgments. The source says additional returns or incentives may be gifts, not that they automatically are gifts. Funding or fulfilment alone does not establish who offers a component; the detailed attribution qualifications in node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b are not independently resolved by the circular.

Passing the selected gift control does not establish overall legality. Section 103 authorisation or exemption supplies no stated gift exception, and a fee discount supplies no exemption from disclosure or advertising duties.
Footnote 1 is supplied, contrary to the disclosure claim's uncertainty annotation. The narrow claim is supported but does not exhaust the accompanying principal-loss disclosure requirement.
The supplied source does not establish operative start or end dates. Temporal runtime safeguards cannot establish the applicable legal version.
These scoped NOT_APPLICABLE assessments do not certify the gift formulas or authorize deleting the separate statutory, disclosure or advertising controls.
